strings.zh: 是不是很享受{NEWLINE}和我们的这场对战呀？{SCROLL}那我们现在交换一下{NEWLINE}电话号码吧？{CLEAR}到时候想对战了{CLEAR}打个电话就可以了。{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: You had fun battling us, right?{SCROLL}So how about we exchange phone{NEWLINE}numbers, and that way if we want to{CLEAR}battle again, we can just give each{CLEAR}other a call? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 这样电话号码就{NEWLINE}交换完成了。
strings.en: All right, now you’ve got our number{NEWLINE}and we have yours.

strings.zh: 你想和我们交换{NEWLINE}电话号码了吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Did you decide you wanted to trade{NEWLINE}numbers after all? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 请收下！{NEWLINE}这块真丸石送给你。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Here you go! This Eviolite is for you.{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0679/5; 真丸石 is item 110, renamed 进化奇石 = Eviolite in the hack (0219 #110); US Oval Stone

strings.zh: 奇怪？{NEWLINE}难道你已经到附近了？{SCROLL}都这么近了{NEWLINE}还有必要打电话吗？{CLEAR}你这人还真奇怪。
strings.en: Huh? Don’t tell me you’re already{NEWLINE}nearby?{SCROLL}We’re this close, so do you really need{NEWLINE}to call? You’re a strange one.
strings.notes: US 0679/6 | RV072: meaning: no 'hobby'; restored the question

strings.zh: 我们的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}变强了　！{SCROLL}前段时间和{VAR:0100:11}{NEWLINE}战斗的时候{CLEAR}也是一招定胜负的。{SCROLL}对了,{NEWLINE}现在是{CLEAR}小古跟你通的电话。
strings.en: Our {VAR:0100:10} has gotten stronger!{SCROLL}The other day, we battled a {VAR:0100:11}{NEWLINE}and settled it with one move.{SCROLL}Oh yeah, by the way, this is Tia on the{NEWLINE}phone.
strings.notes: US 0679/7 | RV072: meaning: 一招定胜负 = won with one move (D-2004)

strings.zh: 我们的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}已经变得很强了,{SCROLL}不过前段时间和{VAR:0100:11}{NEWLINE}战斗的时候,{CLEAR}就差那么一点点就胜利了,{CLEAR}结果被它被跑掉了。{SCROLL}对了,{NEWLINE}现在是{CLEAR}扎古跟你通的电话哦。
strings.en: Our {VAR:0100:10} has{NEWLINE}gotten really strong!{SCROLL}But the other day, we were{NEWLINE}just one hit away from beating{CLEAR}a {VAR:0100:11}, and it ran away.{SCROLL}Oh yeah, by the way, this is Kay.

strings.zh: 之前我们在１４号道路{NEWLINE}发现了{VAR:0100:11}⋯⋯{CLEAR}对吧,小古？{SCROLL}是啊,然后{VAR:0100:11}{NEWLINE}就突然间冲了过来⋯⋯{CLEAR}你说是吗,扎古？{SCROLL}恩,于是{NEWLINE}我们俩吓了一跳,{CLEAR}撒腿就跑。小古,还是你说吧。{SCROLL}仔细一想,我们都{NEWLINE}带着精灵,{CLEAR}应该和它战斗才对,对吧,扎古？{SCROLL}我们两个打电话{NEWLINE}是不是让你很混乱？
strings.en: Earlier we saw a {VAR:0100:11}{NEWLINE}on Route 14. Didn’t we, Tia?{SCROLL}Yeah, then the {VAR:0100:11} suddenly{NEWLINE}charged at us. Didn’t it, Kay?{SCROLL}Yeah, and we were so surprised we{NEWLINE}just ran away. You tell it, Tia.{SCROLL}Come to think of it, we both had{NEWLINE}Pokémon with us, so we should{CLEAR}have battled it, right, Kay?{SCROLL}Is it confusing when we{NEWLINE}both talk on the phone?

strings.zh: 我们三个{NEWLINE}再来一次对战吧。{SCROLL}我们在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}你一定要来哦。
strings.en: Let’s have another battle, the three{NEWLINE}of us.{SCROLL}We’re on {VAR:0104:3}, so be sure{NEWLINE}to come.
strings.notes: US 0679/10 | RV072: softened: 你一定要来哦 = be sure to come

strings.zh: 我们不是约好了{NEWLINE}再战一次的吗？{SCROLL}我们在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}千万别忘了哦。
strings.en: Didn’t we make plans to have{NEWLINE}another battle?{SCROLL}We’re waiting on {VAR:0104:3}, so{NEWLINE}don’t forget, OK?

strings.zh: 难得你给我们打电话,{NEWLINE}就出个谜题给你吧。{SCROLL}⋯⋯　⋯⋯　⋯⋯{SCROLL}现在和你通电话的,{NEWLINE}是小古{CLEAR}还是扎古呢？{SCROLL}⋯⋯　⋯⋯　⋯⋯{NEWLINE}⋯⋯　⋯⋯　⋯⋯{CLEAR}⋯⋯　⋯⋯　⋯⋯{CLEAR}⋯⋯　⋯⋯　⋯⋯{CLEAR}正确答案是⋯⋯{SCROLL}偶尔来看看她们的{NEWLINE}超喜欢俱乐部的{CLEAR}三春。
strings.en: Since you went to the trouble of calling{NEWLINE}us, here’s a riddle for you. ... ... ...{SCROLL}Who are you talking to right now? Tia or{NEWLINE}Kay? ... ... ... ... ... ...{SCROLL}The correct answer is...{SCROLL}Pokéfan Eleanor, who drops by to see{NEWLINE}the twins now and then!
strings.notes: US 0679/12; 三春 = US Eleanor (Fan Club) | RV072: name: 超喜欢俱乐部 is the Pokéfan class (0671#30)

strings.zh: 话说,小古发现了{NEWLINE}一块真丸石。{SCROLL}我们决定把它送给你,{NEWLINE}请你来{VAR:0104:3},{CLEAR}明白了吗？
strings.en: Hey, Tia found an Eviolite.{SCROLL}We decided to give it to you, so{NEWLINE}come to {VAR:0104:3}, OK?
strings.notes: US 0679/13; 真丸石 = item 110 = Eviolite in the hack

strings.zh: 我们在{VAR:0104:3}{NEWLINE}等着给你真丸石啊。
strings.en: We’re waiting at {VAR:0104:3}{NEWLINE}to give you the Eviolite.
strings.notes: US 0679/14; 真丸石 = item 110 = Eviolite in the hack
